purpose: G1 visual-asset evidence and safe viewer decoder specifications

evidence: GUI refresh rectangles use width 0x280 and height 199

decoder_safety: Treat address_end_exclusive as authoritative and reject reads beyond it.
Do not dereference RAM pointer symbols in a static viewer.
Do not read QSPI addresses from app_update.bin; require a separately supplied QSPI dump.
Use dispatch-table frame/glyph counts even when leading or trailing frames are visually blank.
Show semantic labels as inferred unless corroborated by a named call-site constant.

assets.title: Display fade/dither mask atlas

encoding.format: 8 AND-mask frames interleaved by 26 row phases
encoding.display_expansion: tile phase row y % 26 over 199 visible rows

assets.behavior: Each transition step ANDs one mask frame into every nonzero framebuffer byte, then refreshes the 640×199 display.
assets.visual_description: Eight ordered dither masks that progressively erase or reveal a full screen in repeating 26-row bands.
assets.plain_language: The user sees the current screen dissolve in a patterned eight-step fade rather than disappear instantly.

reference_evidence.expression: same mask atlas used for navigation transitions

renderer.viewer: transition preview with before/after test card
renderer.strategy: For frame 0..7 and output row y, select the 320-byte row at (y%26)*0xA00 + 0x8C0-frame*0x140 and AND it with a 4-bpp test framebuffer.
renderer.safe_bounds: Use exactly 26 phase blocks; the address expression remains inside 0x000aae20..0x000bb220.

caveats: The mask is an effect operand, not a standalone picture; preview it over a test image.
